customize.name: Parametric Transformer
customize.desc:
A device that can transmute materials placed within and convert it into some other material.
·During the transmutation process, you must use Elemental Attacks to generate enough energy for the transmutation to take place.
·After obtaining the transmuted materials, you must wait seven days to use it once again.

This mysterious device, discovered within the ruins, has the power to accelerate cycles and "transmute" material objects. Generally speaking, everything is undergoing a cycle. Memories and elements surge within the ley lines, rotten fallen fruits return to the soil, and the trees born from the soil will one day bear their crystalline fruit...

customize.name: Spiral Abyss
customize.desc: The Spiral Abyss is a permanent domain with challenges constantly updated on the 16th of each month. It is unlocked at Adventure Rank 20.

customize.name: Imaginarium Theater
customize.desc:
The Imaginarium Theater is a permanent domain with challenges constantly updated on the 1st of each month. It is unlocked at Adventure Rank 35.

Before the beginning of all stories, after the end of all tales, in the interstice between reality and fantasy, there is an endless drama unfolding, never ceasing upon the stage – There is no beginning, nor an end, for in the telling of the "story," the two differ not.

customize.name: Stygian Onslaught
customize.desc:
Stygian Onslaught is a permanent combat event with challenges regularly updated 8 days after each version update and runs for 5 weeks per phase. It is unlocked at Adventure Rank 20.

A strange Ley Line Disturbance has once again appeared, this time in Liyue's Sal Terrae. You must breach the depths of this unpredictable Domain, for only by defeating powerful foes can the turmoil be quelled... Of course, where danger awaits, so too do extraordinary treasures...

customize.name: Varka's Secret Stash of Cash
customize.desc:
Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.
"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.
Although this money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, now that plans have changed, maybe it can be used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or given to the knight to reward each friend who helped rescue Varka instead.

customize.name: Paimon's "Food Fund"
customize.desc: Paimon used part of her personal "Food Fund" to pay for your commission fee. Hmm, now that you think about it, she probably has more squirreled away, doesn't she?

customize.name: Investment Returns
customize.desc: Returns from one's investment in the portfolio promoted at Mimisbrunnr Books. All investments involve risks, and profit and loss are both common in the industry, but it would seem that generous returns are always an attractive prospect.

customize.name: Amina's Compensation
customize.desc: Remuneration from Amina, as a token of appreciation for helping to convict the scammer "guide."
